notes.title: 1.6.2 - Released
notes.content:
- "Return to Hoth" campaign now available in German and Spanish!
- "The Gray Cap Cantina" raid now available in Spanish!

notes.title: 1.6.1 - Released
notes.content:
- New raid "The Gray Cap Cantina" is now available!
- French language added.
- Various bug fixes.

notes.title: 1.5.0 - Released
notes.content:
• New campaign added: Return to Hoth!
• Reworked activation instructions for the following Imperial groups: Imperial Officer, Probe Droid, Snowtroopers, and Wing Guards.
• Simplified the preferred targets the app chooses for enemy activations.
• Various bugs fixed.

notes.title: 1.4.0 - Released
notes.content:
• Tyrants of Lothal and associated figure packs can now be enabled in the Collection Manager.
• Heroes, allies, enemies, villains and items from these products can now be used in any campaign.
• New enemy sounds added.
• Prevent screen sleep option added.
• Various bugs fixed.

notes.title: 1.3.0 - Released
notes.content:
• New campaign added: Jabba's Realm!
• New Hall of Legends tracks your most famous squads.
• Armory now provides a better range of options.
• Repriced some weapons and mods.
• Added in-app replacement skills for:
        • Smuggler's Luck - Jyn Odan
        • Company of Heroes - Murne Rin
• Added mission-appropriate background audio.
• Removed 'Professional' ability from regular Riot Troopers.
• Updated product URLs in the Collection Manager.
• Various bugs fixed.

notes.title: 1.2.1 - Released
notes.content:
- Heroes incapacitated status minor bugs fixed.
- Encounter "Debt of Gratitude" now awards the Wookie Warrior ally as intended.
- Fixed Captain Terro surge ability.
- Various minor wording and typo fixes.
